'''Izzy-mold''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink appetizer designed by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] tried Izzy-mold while on [[Naos III/Legends|Naos III]].
